notes.title: Version 1.13 small fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899039/6257671f99f94a72f560c9fdba453d6dbdda50ba.png[/img]

 [list]
    [*]There was a rare bug where purple chest could spawn out of bounds. This update prevents that and fixes your save in case you had this bug
    [*]The "Skilled" achievement can now be manually checked via the small icon on the bottom right in the main menu
    [*]The probability for ballons/purple chests is raised by 10% when you build the golden statue. At this point it´s just for the 100%, no need to make it super rare
[/list]

notes.title: Achievements update
notes.content:
[h3][b]v 1.1[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899039/a54c6c4d68c0a91e26e69cd32f53d841a1704dcd.png[/img]

Achievements:
[list]
[*]Added 32 steam achievements to the game
[*]If you´ve played the game before you can click on the little icon on the bottom right of the main menu to scan your savefile for achievements you´ve already completed
[/list]

Gameplay/Balancing:
[list]
[*]Reduced the resource cost of the first 4 submarine upgrade levels
[*]Reduced the coin cost of all upgrades by 10%-15%
[*]Increased the duration of the invincibility buff from 5 to 10 seconds
[*]Rare fish you haven´t completed in the collection are more likely to spawn if you´ve equiped the rare fish mod
[*]Made it easier to obtain fish crowns by lowering the threshold of what small and large fish are. You also get both crowns autimatically after killing 50 of one fish type
[*]Added a new research project
[*]Added a new chest type that let´s you choose your reward
[*]Building the golden statue will make it easier to get various achievements (it tweaks some values to reduce the grind)
[*]Reduced the building cost of the first 3 rocket stages
[/list]

tags.feature: Added 32 steam achievements to the game
If you´ve played the game before you can click on the little icon on the bottom right of the main menu to scan your savefile for achievements you´ve already completed

tags.balance_change: Reduced the resource cost of the first 4 submarine upgrade levels
Reduced the coin cost of all upgrades by 10%-15%
Increased the duration of the invincibility buff from 5 to 10 seconds
Rare fish you haven´t completed in the collection are more likely to spawn if you´ve equiped the rare fish mod
Made it easier to obtain fish crowns by lowering the threshold of what small and large fish are. You also get both crowns autimatically after killing 50 of one fish type

tags.feature: Added a new chest type that let´s you choose your reward

tags.balance_change: Building the golden statue will make it easier to get various achievements (it tweaks some values to reduce the grind)
Reduced the building cost of the first 3 rocket stages

notes.title: Patch 1.093
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899039/adc6acde0229e04817347a063b2431a65ed42081.png[/img]

Patch 1.093

[list]
[*]Balancing: made a lot more buffs lockable
[*]Balancing: Besides dropping double coins, sparkly fish now also have a +2% chance to drop a Deep Sea Collectible
[*]Balancing: large and rare fish are marked as completed in the collection when you kill 5 total to reduce the grind if you go for 100%
[*]Balancing: harvestball mod chance increased from 5% to 10%
[*]Balancing: dash no longer uses battery
[*]Balancing: the katana upgrade now attacks 5 times instead of 3 and displays an icon when you can trigger it

[*]MIsc: The monkey now has a small animation
[*]MIsc: You can toogle mouse lock now in the ini file
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update

In detail:

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*]added small pickups for the submarine
[*]added construction materials and 2 construction objects
[*]added bufflocking mechanic
[*]reduced drops from chests
[*]made it more obvious when you can receive level-up rewards
[/list]

[b]Bugfix:[/b]
[list]
[*]knifing a barrel no longer leads to a crash
[*]fixed an issue with rockets being destroyed upon spawn sometimes
[*]fixed dummy having negative damage numbers
[*]fixed enemies not deactivating after leaving room
[*]water reflections now work everywhere
[*]fix an issue related to euqipping another hat
[/list]
